stage_role: program registration, parent repair, failure-mode audit and family-level preflight

parent.process: Q72 -> F00 -> S0/S1-12 x six mu -> T1 -> H1_GLOBAL

layers.P1: globally scaled pathway prediction with eta_quick and eta_gw
layers.P2: station-conditioned prediction with the frozen ridge contract

required_repairs: audit H1 with the segmentwise identity sum(L_i*W_i/(86400*Q_i)); never divide reach travel time by mean depth
hard-gate Q72 quick-plus-groundwater closure and routed nitrogen mass closure
withdraw the existing Laplace/PyMC uncertainty as non-authoritative because it is not centered on the production optimum
record the current bilevel objective: sample log-SSE for eta and station/tree-macro score for structure
supersede the 20260824_2 synthetic implementation with registered log1p eta fitting, a real phi=0 endpoint, untruncated log-scale noise and an input lock
reclassify 20260824_3 as PROCESS_NOT_SUPPORTED_PREDICTION_PRESERVED and record phi=1 boundary confounding
produce formal P0/P1/P2 absolute and station-demeaned anomaly metrics

time_boundary.q72_2022_rule: may be read only for frozen-input integrity and coverage

F1.mean_equation_parent: H1_GLOBAL routed quick and groundwater TN divided by Q72 routed water
F1.student_t: fixed nu=4 on log1p(TN); no fitted degrees of freedom
F1.cq_hinge: z=log(Q72)-training-station median log(Q72); g(z)=beta_low*min(z,0)+beta_high*max(z,0); thresholds use all training-year Q72 months
F1.nesting: beta_low=beta_high=0 exactly reproduces the corresponding non-hinge arm
diagnostics_only: eta upper bound relaxed from 1 to 2

F2.L1: one shared nonpoint catchment memory placed before the quick/GW split and replacing post-GW T1 at equal memory complexity
F2.L2: one-parameter effective loss driven by a fold-frozen Q72 antecedent-wetness anomaly
F2.L3: geometrically normalized MPR: quick delivery varies with reach slope and groundwater delivery with GLHYMPS permeability
F2.forbidden: source-specific free lags or a second simultaneous memory unless synthetic recovery first proves separability

F3.residence_time: attenuation driven by Q72 flow and Andreadis width/depth/length travel time, without reference discharge
F3.saturation: H1 removal with fixed K_N grid {0,0.5,1,2} mg/L; K_N=0 is the registered parent endpoint

stopping_rule: Do not add candidates after the registered graph. Stop after independent F1/F2/F3 decisions and at most one authorized joint test.
